purpose: Correct the existing native Empty Trash path with read-only bounded pages, explicit selected batches, retained nondeleting containers, fresh confirmation per batch and truthful bounded receipts. Full-scope publication and qualification remain pending.

authority.surface_owner: Swift reads metadata through one retained non-main I/O actor; select/apply typed Go reports use unchanged runCaptured
prohibited: no recursive remove or discovery during execution

browse_v3.work: one retained public fdopendir/readdir stream, at most 32 rows/leaf stats, 34 readdir API calls and 34816 name bytes per page; report actual API calls/name bytes, not underlying syscall counts
browse_v3.continuation: view-owned UUID plus exact sequence and folder generation; same stream retained, no cross-open cookie or token registry; serialized non-main I/O actor
browse_v3.lifecycle: refresh/navigation/dismiss/cancel/60-second idle expiry fence publication immediately and coalesce close on same I/O owner; closing remains pending until acknowledgement; before apply await close then recheck consent
browse_v3.blocked: stat_failed/unsupported_type/unowned/cross_device/invalid_path rows are not selectable; continuation advances over all inspected names; root/container failure still refuses
browse_v3.unsupported: stateless Go browse explicitly refuses; union-directory libc read-all mode refused; no private symbol, cgo, daemon or extra child runner

inputs: browse v3: retained native metadata-only session, bounded eligible/blocked rows and UUID/sequence/generation; session is not deletion authorization

select at most 32 eligible roots; selected batch: at most 1024 recursive members, 64 total retained directories and depth 24; each actual Swift-encoded request and approved manifest must fit existing runner 64 KiB stdin
effective UID and no-follow dev/inode/type/mode/size/mtime/ctime identities
frozen selected manifest plus nondeleting container ancestors and fresh explicit confirmation per batch
outputs: read-only browse pages and continuation or stale-generation refusal
ordered selected deleted prefix, advisory logical bytes and errors
retained bounded capture and explicit unknown completion debt
writes: only selected reviewed members through descriptor-relative bottom-up nonrecursive unlink/rmdir after full selected-scope preflight comparison; container ancestors are retained and never deleted
upgrade_recipe: keep existing platform.EmptyTrash and legacy CLI path unchanged for other callers
retain strict exact key sets and duplicate/path/type validation for selection and apply
retain native metadata-only stream in one non-main I/O actor; no lookahead, EOF rescan, cross-open cookie or token registry
require exact retained-stream coverage and real work bounds; preserve immutable b966 failed qualification and reject stateless CLI success
fence stale/cancelled publication; close on same serial owner and distinguish close pending from acknowledged close
retain blocked rows and continuation over all inspected names without admitting blocked identities into selection
offer smaller selection or folder descent when a whole directory cannot fit a batch
capture a selected directory recursively and completely or retain it only as a nondeleting container for selected descendants
preflight all selected members before any delete; do not require unrelated unselected sibling inventory or container timestamps to match
retain root/container dev/inode/UID/type/mode and each selected member's full review identity
never discover additional deletion candidates after preflight
preserve late additions and report a nonempty selected-directory rmdir as partial
do not widen existing runCaptured stdin/output/time bounds
claim cooperative ordinary owner protection, not atomic stat/unlink against hostile same-UID mutation
keep malformed/nonzero/incomplete capture distinct from success
Review next batch is read-only and requires new confirmation; never auto-replay deletion
retain original operation receipt if a remaining-items read fails
qualify large paged inventory, oversized-folder descendant selection, preserved siblings, drift, aliases and actual Swift-encoded byte limits before installed acceptance
